items.problem: Bootstrap self-check ran before bootstrap completed and returned False.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 97-135 show the two commands launched together; lines 137-202 show the sequential retry returned True.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 0 says the literal first three PowerShell commands are ordered and explicitly says not to proceed until Test-Path returns True.
items.why_no_skill_change: The required ordering and gate are already explicit and prominent.

items.problem: dotnet run was first invoked from a directory with no project.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2677-2699: the first invocation failed, then --project with the csproj succeeded in locating the project.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 3 commands use the WinUI project root/target, and Test-AppLaunch's Target parameter is defined as the folder containing the csproj.
items.why_no_skill_change: Passing the actual project path is normal command targeting, not a migration-specific knowledge gap.

items.problem: Explicit Compile items caused NETSDK1022 duplicate source inclusion.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Project File Updates' says UWP explicit Compile Include items do not build under the SDK-style target and says not to copy the UWP csproj.
items.why_no_skill_change: The agent fetched the csproj anchor before adding the prohibited explicit Compile items.

items.problem: The agent linked shared XAML through brittle relative/absolute paths, then regenerated it, causing WMC9999 and missing generated members.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2812-2868 and 3295-3299 show repeated link changes followed by creation of a replacement local XAML file.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Critical Rules > Fidelity says not to regenerate XAML and to copy each XAML file verbatim before transforming it.
items.why_no_skill_change: The existing fidelity rule directly prohibits both the eventual regeneration and failure to preserve the source XAML.

items.problem: Deleting MainWindow while App still referenced it caused CS0246 and an incoherent shell.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 1967-1977 delete MainWindow; lines 2867-2868 report missing MainWindow.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Shell conversion and navigation invariants require choosing a coherent target shell and preserving reachability; the single-page option is a Page hosted directly under Window.
items.why_no_skill_change: Deleting a referenced type without updating its caller is a local edit consistency error.

items.problem: All migration mapping rows remained copied until the validator failed.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3471-3498: validator found five copied rows and the agent then changed them to done.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 1 says to flip each row from copied to done/deferred, and Step 4 lists copied rows as a validator failure.
items.why_no_skill_change: The validator caught the omission and the existing instructions already state the exact fix.
